text: Owner decisions 2026-09-23 (in claude-release session), superseding this bead's 'moves only' scope: (1) AGENTS.md declares multi-agent via Fray as the operating mode (Fray coordination, Mote tickets, named lead integrates/lands, gate lock, T1-T7); still-valid single-developer rules keep their ids. (2) Rewrite the core as a tight current guide (~350-450 lines); move fleet governance, rule 4 full text and long incident anecdotes VERBATIM to docs/ with stable ids and links. Constraints kept: no normative rule silently dropped; every id (L1-L10, SD1-SD8, rules 1-14, rule 4 sub-rules) still resolves; fresh-context audit before landing.
